QUOTE: #ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif — "Struct fields are declared as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(foo)`, so by default a field `foo` is actually named `private_foo`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both branches and explains that code defining the opt-out gets plain names (the library and sample programs get direct access) while everything else sees the mangled `private_` names.
